compute.firewalls.create: To create the firewall rules that allow traffic to and from the exocompute cluster.
compute.networks.access: To access the VPC network, so the cluster nodes can be created in it.
compute.networks.create: To create the VPC network that the exocompute cluster runs in.
compute.networks.delete: To delete the VPC network exocompute created when it is removed.
compute.networks.get: To get the VPC network, so it can be reused when it already exists.
compute.networks.update: To update the settings of the VPC network.
compute.networks.updatePolicy: To update the network firewall policy, which creating, changing and deleting firewall rules requires.
compute.networks.use: To use the VPC network, so subnets, routers and cluster nodes can be attached to it.
compute.routers.create: To create the Cloud Router that hosts the NAT for the cluster nodes.
compute.routers.delete: To delete the Cloud Router exocompute created when it is removed.
compute.routers.get: To get the Cloud Router, so it can be reused when it already exists.
compute.routers.update: To update the Cloud Router, so its NAT configuration matches what exocompute needs.
compute.subnetworks.create: To create the subnet, with secondary ranges for pods, that the cluster nodes use.
compute.subnetworks.delete: To delete the subnet exocompute created when it is removed.
compute.subnetworks.expandIpCidrRange: To update the subnet primary IP range, so the cluster has enough node addresses.
compute.subnetworks.get: To get the subnet, so it can be reused and its IP ranges reconciled.
compute.subnetworks.update: To update the subnet secondary IP ranges, so the cluster has enough pod addresses.
compute.subnetworks.use: To use the subnet for the nodes of the exocompute cluster.

compute.firewalls.delete: To delete the firewall rules exocompute created when it is removed.
compute.firewalls.get: To get a firewall rule exocompute created, so it can be reused or checked.
compute.firewalls.update: To update a firewall rule exocompute created, such as the Rubrik addresses it allows.
